SC Delays Hearing on Karur Stampede Case Plea

The Supreme Court of India has delayed hearing a plea by Vijay, the brother of a victim in the Karur stampede case, regarding the state government's plan to control crowd movement. The delay comes after the SC declined to hear a separate plea by DMK leaders over remarks made during the case. The Karur stampede occurred on May 10, resulting in 13 deaths and injuring many others. Vijay's plea seeks to challenge the state government's plan, while DMK leaders had requested the SC to intervene over comments made by TVK leaders during the case.
